integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses only the exact iterate formula, Minkowski's inequality, and a one-variable monotonicity argument. No numerical experiment, finite enumeration, external certification, or independence claim is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to Arnold's extremal positive weighted shift. It does not classify all extremizers, extend the exact formula to arbitrary weighted shifts or arbitrary p-absolutely Cesàro bounded operators, or determine weak-endpoint constants. An older equivalent finite-section inequality under weighted Hardy-matrix terminology remains a literature risk.
title: Exact harmonic finite-horizon profile at the extremal Cesàro endpoint
